text: This is Sellix POS. The register your café runs on.
Tap to ring up an order. Tax is worked out for you.
Cash, card or GCash. Change, done instantly.
Then the receipt prints straight to your thermal printer.
Track today's sales, catch low stock early, and turn every sale into reports.
On Android or desktop, it keeps selling even when the internet drops.
Shifts, returns, deliveries, customers and an audit log. Built in.
